emma: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. Need compact owners + strict due dates for the rollout safety items (auto-rollback, cohort defaults, metric gates, synthetic canary). Reply with one-line commitments I can paste into the tracker.

ryan: I'll own auto-rollback controller and tests. Plan: add rollback-hook step, end-to-end test that simulates failures, then staged deploy to canary nodes. Ticket ROL-5001. Due: 2025-04-15.

camila: I'll take cohort defaults + flag-page UX. Proposal: 0.2% initial for 1h, ramp to 2% over 24h, hard max 10% unless approved. Will file ROL-5002 and mock the UI. Due: 2025-03-31.

sre-oncall: I'll implement the synthetic canary job and wire a canary_success_rate metric into the console. Job runs every 5m, small query set + healthprobe. Ticket ROL-5003. Due: 2025-03-28.

ryan: For abort semantics: pause on single-signal breach, auto-abort only after two corroborating signals (metric gate + canary fail) within 10m. I'll document thresholds in the PR.

camila: Will include migration notes for existing flags (no change until org flips to new defaults) and an opt-in script for orgs that want earlier ramp.

docops: I'll draft a short customer blurb and an internal one-paragraph runbook entry (who presses abort, where in console). Ticket ROL-5004. Due: 2025-04-02.
